close_reason: Already fixed: CRLF check uses single array + iterator pattern, not sequential if-flag blocks.
description: handle_mdn_send (crate-jmap-mail-server/src/mdn.rs:191-229) checks CRLF in five optional Mdn fields using five sequential 'if \!crlf_bad { if let Some(...) }' blocks. This hides the logical predicate and means adding a new field to Mdn silently skips the check with no compiler warning. Replace with an iterator over the present &str values so the predicate is explicit and field additions are visible at the call site.
notes: Round 2: CRLF block now covers 7 fields (subject, text_body, reporting_ua, final_recipient, extension_fields, mdn_gateway, original_message_id — up from 5 in round 1 description). mdn.rs:200-252. Pattern is measurably worse; severity unchanged at P3.
title: mdn.rs: CRLF check uses imperative flag loop
